title: John Lear possibly fed disinformation to Lazar
summary: Jesse Michels tells of John Lear possibly fed disinformation to Lazar, about 1970s-1989 at United States (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Bob Lazar would hang around some interesting characters. Guys like John Lear, who flew cargo planes for the CIA in the seventies.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, points out that Bob Lazar, a man who has told a famous story about secret alien technology, spent time with some unusual people. One was John Lear, who according to Michels flew cargo planes for the CIA, the US foreign intelligence agency, in the 1970s. The idea behind the story is that Lear may have fed Lazar disinformation, meaning false information planted on purpose, which if true would mean Lazar's story was shaped by someone else.
